newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan to issue T$8 bln NCDs on Friday.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan to issue T$8 bln NCDs on Friday.

text.p: Taiwan's central bank said on Friday it would issue T$8 billion in one-month negotiable certificates of deposit later in the day.
Bids would close at 15.00 local time (0700 GMT), a central bank official said.
The central bank has said its NCD issue was responding to the banking system's liquidity sitution.
On Thursday, Taiwan's money rates closed lower amid widespread expectations that liquidity would remain loose during the June reserve period that opened on Wednesday.

During a sustained stock rally in March and April, the central bank repeatedly issued NCDs, a move seen as aiming to keep a lid on the loose liquidity that many experts said had been fuelling what then was a sizzling stock market.
The central bank had denied that it was acting directly in response to the stock market bull run.
